plugin_desc: Pica8 PicOS white-box switch-specific SNMP collection (PICA-PRIVATE-MIB, IANA PEN 35098). PicOS exposes public IF-MIB plus its private MIB only (it does not use NET-SNMP UCD or HOST-RESOURCES MIBs). Control-plane CPU is collected as a top-level inputs.snmp.field with instance .0: cpuUsage 1.3.6.1.4.1.35098.1.1.0 (INTEGER 0..100) maps to device_cpu_usage. Memory (totalPhyMemory/usedPhyMemory/freePhyMemory) and temperature (switchTemperature/cpuTemperature/switchChipTemperature) are DisplayString rather than numeric gauges, so they are not collected as Gauge (N/A). Fan and power-supply are not collected (N/A). Standard IF-MIB interface metrics are kept. Supported brands/models — Pica8 white-box switches running PicOS (PICA8-series and partner ODM hardware).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Pica8 PicOS device control plane from PICA-PRIVATE-MIB cpuUsage (INTEGER 0..100), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
